metrics.groups: within-chunk = GRASP + RELEASE; cross-chunk = HANDOFF + TRANSPORT
metrics.labelled: post hoc; development read; no training; changes no earlier verdict
metrics.mapping: per model (pi05, groot) and layout: E = new pairing's rate minus the mean of its object and target partners; a group BREAKS iff CI lower > 0 and E > 0.10. within only WITHIN-CHUNK; cross only CROSS-CHUNK; both BOTH; neither NEITHER. P_min and servo reported with no verdict
metrics.prediction: WITHIN-CHUNK for both models in the familiar layout, carried by RELEASE; NEITHER in the new layout
metrics.stage_rule: failures, first match: GRASP never held; HANDOFF held, dmin > 0.10, d shrank < half; TRANSPORT held, dmin > 0.10, shrank >= half; RELEASE dmin <= 0.10 and still held at end or last held > 0.03; PHYSICS dmin <= 0.10 and last held <= 0.03
metrics.states: dev only: N2 main states 4-23, N2 seeds; no confirmatory or sealed read; demos never executed
metrics.written_before: any main atlas run or read
